label: BAC
definition: Approved budget at completion from active governed budget version
insufficient_data_behavior: Blocked if no active budget version

label: PV
definition: Time-phased budget planned to be earned by status date using preserved baseline
insufficient_data_behavior: Blocked when baseline timing missing; 0 when status date is before planned start

label: EV
definition: Value earned from approved quantity first and approved physical percent second
formula: Approved quantity × unit budget value; fallback BAC × approved percent
confidence_behavior: High for quantity-based; Medium for schedule-based
insufficient_data_behavior: Blocked when neither approved quantity nor approved physical percent exists

label: AC
definition: Recognized actual cost linked to governed budget lines
confidence_behavior: High when open actual-cost count is 0
insufficient_data_behavior: Partial or blocked when receipt/accounting linkage is incomplete

label: CV
insufficient_data_behavior: Blocked if EV or AC blocked

label: CPI
insufficient_data_behavior: Blocked when AC denominator is 0 or incomplete

label: SPI
insufficient_data_behavior: Null when PV denominator is 0; never faked to green

label: ETC
definition: Estimate to complete from C7 remaining-work forecast
formula: Inherited C7 remaining-work forecast allocated by governed unit lineage
insufficient_data_behavior: Null when no remaining governed forecast exists at the current grain

label: EAC
definition: Estimate at completion from recognized AC plus governed ETC
published: Partial when ETC or AC is incomplete

label: TCPI
insufficient_data_behavior: Null when denominator is not valid after full earned completion or zero remaining BAC
